if grep -q 'needle' <<<"$out"; then echo hit; fi
n="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c '^ok ')"
lines="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -v '^#')"
first="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -n 'x' | head -1)"
only="$(printf '%s' "$cell" | grep -oE '[0-9]+')"
